elder_seed.name: Elder Seed
elder_seed.lore: A seed that hums. The Seed Offering Shrine in the Bloom Court wants it.

elder_key.name: Elder Key
elder_key.lore: Opens the root-bound door to the Elderroot Sanctuary.

waves.say: The ring of blooms wilts. Blighted things crawl out of the roots.

onDone.text: The blooms open again. An Elder Seed lies in the moss.
The hedge draws back from the gate. Beyond it, a ravine opens.

mechanics.doneText: The shrubs rustle: the pattern is right.

onDone.text: A curtain of ferns parts in the north wall.

mechanics.failText: The pads fall quiet. Think of the sun.

onOpen.text: The hedge withers back. Stairs of root lead down to the Seed Vault.

mechanics.hint: A shrine of living moss, a hollow for a seed.
mechanics.verb: plants the Elder Seed and the hedge withers away.

onOpen.text: The way to the Elderroot Sanctuary is open.

mechanics.hint: A door of knotted roots with a keyhole of bark.
mechanics.verb: turns the Elder Key and the door of roots unknots.

encounters.say: Roots shift among the planters. The glasshouse is not empty.
The flowers bloom in the order of the sun: east, south, west, north. A seed shrine waits in the south.

bosses.name: The Elderroot Warden
bosses.intro: The Elderroot Warden tears free of the roots. Strike the three bloom buds on the pillars to break its bark.
bosses.deathText: The Elderroot Warden withers and the sanctuary exhales.

shield.breakText: The bark splits! Strike the Warden now!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Elderroot Warden calls its servants.

completion.intro: The Elderroot Conservatory. Prune the gate, cross the ravine, and carry the seed to the Bloom Court.
completion.message: The roots go still. The conservatory closes shortly.
